AdminAttachAccountRequest.title: AdminAttachAccountRequest
AdminAttachAccountRequest.description: Request body for attaching account to admin.

AdminCreateRequest.title: AdminCreateRequest
AdminCreateRequest.description:
Request body for creating a new admin.

actor_admin_id is NOT here.
It comes from JWT / request context.

AdminResponse.title: AdminResponse
AdminResponse.description:
Web response model.

It can be created from AdminResponseDTO dataclass using:

    AdminResponse.model_validate(dto)

because from_attributes=True.

AdminUpdateRequest.title: AdminUpdateRequest
AdminUpdateRequest.description: Request body for updating admin personal/contact data.

DepartmentCreateRequest.title: DepartmentCreateRequest
DepartmentCreateRequest.description:
Request body for creating Department.

actor_admin_id is NOT here.
It comes from JWT / request context.

TicketCompleteWorkRetroactivelyRequest.title: TicketCompleteWorkRetroactivelyRequest
TicketCompleteWorkRetroactivelyRequest.description:
Register already completed work.

Domain validates that either:

    actual_started_at + actual_finished_at

or:

    positive duration

is supplied.

TicketFinishWorkRequest.title: TicketFinishWorkRequest
TicketFinishWorkRequest.description:
Finish current work.

Work moves to READY_FOR_REVIEW. A separate execute request
performs administrative finalization.

TicketResponse.title: TicketResponse
TicketResponse.description:
Web representation of internal Ticket.

Field names must correspond to TicketResponseDTO.

TicketStartRemoteWorkRequest.title: TicketStartRemoteWorkRequest
TicketStartRemoteWorkRequest.description:
Special operation for Ticket where remote work is recommended.

Work mode is always remote, therefore work_is_remote is not supplied.

TicketStartWorkRequest.title: TicketStartWorkRequest
TicketStartWorkRequest.description:
Normal ASSIGNED -> AT_WORK.

work_is_remote describes this concrete work episode.

TicketUrgency.title: TicketUrgency
TicketUrgency.description:
Urgency of an internal Ticket.

NORMAL:
    Normal request.

URGENT:
    Request requiring increased priority.

MAINTENANCE:
    Maintenance-related request.
